chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked him about a man washing his wife. He said: “Yes. It is only her family who prevent him from doing so out of partisanship.”

key_terms.يُغَسِّلُ: to wash the deceased body ritually

ai.seo_question: Is a husband allowed to wash his deceased wife in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting a man to wash his deceased wife. It also notes that objections to this practice may come from her family due to social partisanship rather than religious prohibition.
